title: Separate IFX Windows product certification from V4 portability evidence
goal: Make Windows-full and certification controls the blocking requirements for the Windows Server-only IFX product while retaining Linux-complete as explicit non-blocking V4/rule portability evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: The IFX certification report emits separate productCertification and portabilityAssessment decisions.
Windows-full and certification controls remain blocking; a Linux failure or semantic mismatch is recorded as advisory-fail without rejecting an otherwise passing IFX Windows product result.
The pinned network-disabled Linux assessment is still executed and all available process, report and failure evidence is retained.
Focused policy tests cover every blocking and advisory outcome without requiring another full certification run.
Generic V4 dual-platform release contracts, Host inputs, module semantics, bundle bytes, locks and published packages remain unchanged.
The decision record classifies shared workspace evidence as an IFX candidate optimization, not a published V4 Host capability.
